baseline.interpretation: HEARTBEAT carries no settings; HEARTBEAT_ACK does. A ~30s/~45s cadence against a 2s/2s local file proves the Hub-pushed runtime settings are applied by the Agent.

transition.note: the pending pre-change heartbeat tick is expected to land inside the settle window (old interval 24-36 s) and is therefore excluded from the steady-state measurement below

max_log_truncation.interpretation: with max_log_bytes=2048 the same script must be cut to 2048 bytes on both the Agent journal and the Hub row, and be flagged truncated

idempotent_manual.premise: each manual Run Now gets a fresh Hub-created Execution UUID; the UUID is the idempotency key for the Execution-finished upload

duplicate_delivery.mechanism: frame proxy forwarded the same EXECUTION_FINISHED frame (same Execution ID) to the repair Hub a second time

reupload_same_execution_id.mechanism: harness withheld one Hub->Agent EXECUTION_ACK for m2, then cut and restored the child connection so the product re-upload path ran
